scripts.dev: npm run tokens && npm run tokens:demo && npm run tokens:stage && astro dev
scripts.build: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:styles && npm run tokens && npm run tokens:demo && npm run tokens:stage && astro check && astro build
scripts.tokens:demo: node ../tools/build-css.mjs --brands aurum,nova,fiesta,ultra --brand-file aurum=../tokens/demo/brand/aurum.json --brand-file nova=../tokens/demo/brand/nova.json --brand-file fiesta=../tokens/demo/brand/fiesta.json --brand-file ultra=../tokens/demo/brand/ultra.json --no-demo-components --components-file ../tokens/demo/components.json --out-css src/generated/demo/tokens.css --out-meta src/generated/demo/meta.json --out-manifest src/generated/demo/manifest.json
scripts.tokens:stage: node ../tools/build-css.mjs --brands aurum,nova,fiesta,ultra --brand-file aurum=../tokens/demo/brand/aurum.json --brand-file nova=../tokens/demo/brand/nova.json --brand-file fiesta=../tokens/demo/brand/fiesta.json --brand-file ultra=../tokens/demo/brand/ultra.json --site-sets ../tokens/site --brand-extra ../tokens/site/demo-motion.json --no-demo-components --components-file ../tokens/components.json --components-file ../tokens/demo/components.json --only-components card,header,chip,promo,art,gameTile,button,illustration,stageLight --scope .stage-scope --out-css src/generated/stage/stage.css --out-meta src/generated/stage/meta.json --out-manifest src/generated/stage/manifest.json
